name: Aegle
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 96 Aegle: diameter 177.774 ± 1.543 km; JPL's stated reference: urn:nasa:pds:neowise_diameters_albedos::2.0[mainbelt] (http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...759L...8M)
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 177.774 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Aegle. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
introduction: J. Coggia found Aegle at Marseille on 17 February 1868.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 177.774 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
